// Fixture generator for #1196 (not part of this commit's tree): a real
// schema-4 bundle written by this commit's own SessionRepository.save.
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:loopy_engine/loopy_engine.dart';
import 'package:session_repository/session_repository.dart';

import 'helpers/fake_session_engine.dart';

Float32List pcm(int frames, double value) =>
    Float32List.fromList(List.filled(frames, value));

String get out => Platform.environment['FIXTURE_OUT']!;

SessionRepository repoFor(AudioEngine engine) => SessionRepository(
  engine: engine,
  clearPollInterval: Duration.zero,
  clearPollAttempts: 4,
);

void main() {
  test('generate', () async {
    final engine = FakeSessionEngine()
      ..seedLayers(0, [pcm(2400, 0.25), pcm(2400, 0.375)], undoDepth: 1)
      ..seedTrack(1, pcm(4800, 0.5), multiple: 2, volume: 0.5, muted: true)
      ..seedLane(1, 1, pcm(4800, 0.125), volume: 1.5, outputMask: 0x1)
      ..tempoBpm = 110
      ..tempoSource = TempoSource.manual
      ..tsNum = 3
      ..quantizeDiv = GridDivision.bar
      ..clickMode = ClickMode.rec
      ..clickMask = 0x2
      ..countInBars = 2
      ..looperMode = LooperMode.sync
      ..primaryTrack = 0
      ..oneShot[1] = true;
    await repoFor(engine).save(
      '$out/v4_loopy_fb8d7cc2b',
      chains: SessionChains(
        laneChains: [
          SessionLaneChain(
            channel: 0,
            lane: 0,
            encoded: encodeTrackEffects([
              BuiltInEffect(type: TrackEffectType.delay),
            ]),
          ),
        ],
        monitors: [
          SessionMonitor(
            input: 0,
            enabled: true,
            outputMask: 3,
            volume: 1.5,
            muted: false,
            encoded: encodeTrackEffects([
              BuiltInEffect(type: TrackEffectType.reverb),
            ]),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  });
}
